items.summary: NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit contains a missing-authentication flaw that lets a remote attacker access the toolkit without logging in, potentially leading to code execution, privilege escalation, data tampering, denial of service and information disclosure. Fixed in NeMo Agent Toolkit 1.9.0.

Adobe Campaign Classic is affected by a code-injection vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user; a low-privileged attacker could exploit it with no user interaction required. Fixed in Campaign Classic 7.4.4 build 9403 (APSB26-162).

Adobe Campaign Classic is affected by an OS command-injection vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user; a low-privileged attacker could exploit it with no user interaction required. Fixed in Campaign Classic 7.4.4 build 9403 (APSB26-162).

Dell PowerProtect Data Domain contains an improper-authentication vulnerability that lets an unauthenticated attacker with remote access exploit it to run arbitrary commands with root privileges. Upgrade to a fixed DD OS release (DSA-2026-416) at the earliest opportunity.

An OS command-injection vulnerability in the AutomatedProvisioner in Juniper Networks Session Smart Conductor allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root via a specially crafted salt minion ID. Apply Juniper's fix (JSA112183) and restrict remote access where possible.
